latest_release.name: Berserk 14
latest_release.body:
## Berserk 14

Berserk 14 is officially available!

> ⚠️ **About these binaries:** The attached `.exe` files are **cross-compiled from Linux with mingw-w64 and are _not_ PGO-optimized**. They will run correctly but are slower than a native, profile-guided build. For best performance you are **strongly encouraged to compile your own native binary** (instructions below), it tunes the build to your exact CPU.

## Build it yourself (recommended)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/jhonnold/berserk
cd berserk/src
make pgo CC=clang ARCH=native
./berserk bench
```

`make pgo` produces a profile-guided, native-tuned binary and will be faster than any of the generic binaries attached here.

## Choosing a prebuilt binary

All binaries require `popcnt`. Pick by your CPU's instruction set: `x86-64`, `sse41`, `avx2`, `avx512`.

Binaries tagged `pext` require `bmi2`. **AMD Zen / Zen 2 users: avoid `pext` binaries, `pext` is emulated and slow on those chips.**

If unsure:
- Download a few, run `go depth 24` in each; if it crashes your CPU lacks that instruction set.
- Pick the fastest one that runs or just build natively (above).
